package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for success_response_contains_error_field_or_mixed_contract: Endpoints that blend success and error shapes into one ambiguous contract.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type APIResponse struct {
	Success bool              `json:"success"`
	Data    interface{}       `json:"data"`
	Error   string            `json:"error"`
	Errors  map[string]string `json:"errors"`
}

type CreateResult struct {
	ID   int    `json:"id"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func CreateItemHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	result := CreateResult{ID: 99, Name: "NewItem"}

	resp := APIResponse{
		Success: true,
		Data:    result,
		Error:   "",
		Errors:  nil,
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}

func GetItemHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	result := CreateResult{ID: 42, Name: "ExistingItem"}

	resp := APIResponse{
		Success: true,
		Data:    result,
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(resp)
}
